title: mlipx beta scientific validation summary
description: Version 2 aggregates per profile identity instead of per engine, keeps every run of the same computation visible, seeds the support matrix from the declared model manifest (missing evidence is 'not_run', never pass) and carries an explicit import exit contract.

profiles.description: observed profile identities (profile_id -> full identity); never merged across artifact hash, dtype, task/head, inference mode, device class, commit or suite revision

support_matrix.description: engine x property support as OBSERVED from t1 records, seeded with the declared manifest engines; 'not_run' and 'unsupported' are distinct states and statuses never regress to pass because of file ordering

cases.description: case_id -> test_id -> profile_id -> {status, runs[]}; every run stays visible

problems.description: records that failed structural/semantic validation; never dropped silently

harness_violations.description: calculator identity outside the allowed mlipx wrapper modules (taskbook section 47); non-empty means the suite is compromised

import_summary.description: counts behind the aggregator exit code

expected_matrix.description: declared evidence (from the model manifest) versus observed engines; missing_engines non-empty means incomplete evidence
